verdict.rationale: Anytype explicitly documents local-only mode that disables the vendor's backup node entirely so data never leaves the local network, offline-first local storage by default, and a self-hosted sync backend option (Docker image maintained by the team, network configuration for backing up to your own network) as an alternative to the vendor cloud. This is corroborated by a co-founder community comment confirming p2p sync works well on local networks. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of running the self-hosted Docker backend end-to-end, and community reports note some friction (e.g. data not fully encrypted on disk historically) rather than pure first-party confirmation.
